scoring_justification: The target quantities are final outputs of a full SCF geometry scan that cannot be recomputed in the verifier; comparing the agent's reported values to the paper's reported values with appropriate tolerances (different software package) is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for the five Cr=C double bond properties
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table II (bond length, bond energy, rotational barrier, charges) and Figure 11 (atomic charges)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the published tables and figure in the source paper
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual values reported in the paper; they constitute the hidden ground truth for replication

outputs.description: Reproduced key quantitative properties of the Cr=C double bond: equilibrium bond length, bond dissociation energy (to singlet fragments), rotational barrier, and Mulliken gross atomic charges on Cr and carbene carbon, as computed by ab initio SCF with minimal basis sets.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares each numeric field in results.json to the corresponding paper-reported value, applying tolerances appropriate for a re-implementation of the same method with a different software package.

steps.description: Bond dissociation energy to singlet fragments
Mulliken gross atomic charge on Cr
Mulliken gross atomic charge on carbene carbon
